en.s: Simon de Montfort's Parliament was an English parliament held from 20 January 1265 until mid-March of the same year, called by Simon de Montfort, a baronial rebel leader. Montfort had seized power in England following his victory over Henry III at the Battle of Lewes during the Second Barons' War, but his grip on the country was under threat.

zh.s: 西蒙·德·蒙福特议会是英国的一届议会，1265年1月20日召开，持续到当年3月中旬。议会由男爵叛军领袖西蒙·德·蒙福特召集。此前，蒙福特在第二次男爵战争中于刘易斯战役击败亨利三世，夺取了英国的权力，但他对全国的控制正受到威胁。

en.t: Władysław I Łokietek crowned king of Poland
en.s: On 20 January 1320, Władysław I Łokietek was crowned king of Poland at Wawel Cathedral in Kraków. The archbishop of Gniezno, Janisław, performed the coronation.

zh.t: 瓦迪斯瓦夫一世加冕为波兰国王
zh.s: 1320年1月20日，瓦迪斯瓦夫一世在克拉科夫的瓦维尔主教座堂加冕为波兰国王。格涅兹诺大主教亚尼斯瓦夫主持了加冕仪式。

en.t: Viborg assembly offers the Danish crown to Frederick
en.s: On 20 January 1523, the assembly at Viborg, Denmark, offered the Danish crown to Christian II’s uncle, Duke Frederick of Holstein, during the rebellion against Christian.

zh.t: 维堡会议推举弗雷德里克为丹麦国王
zh.s: 1523年1月20日，在反对克里斯蒂安二世的叛乱中，丹麦维堡的会议向他的叔父、荷尔斯泰因公爵弗雷德里克提出继承丹麦王位。

en.s: Consequently, in December 1527, taking a circumlocutious route Babur marched to the fortress of Chanderi in Malwa. Upon reaching Chanderi, on January 20, 1528, Babur offered Shamsabad to Medini Rao in exchange for Chanderi as a peace overture, but the offer was rejected by Rao. The outer fortress of Chanderi was taken by Babur's army at night, and the next morning the upper fort was captured. Babur himself expressed surprise that the upper fort had fallen within an hour of the final assault. Medini Rai organized the terrible Jauhar ceremony during which women and children within the fortress were killed.

zh.s: 1527年12月，巴布尔绕道进军马尔瓦的昌德里要塞。1528年1月20日抵达后，他提出以沙姆萨巴德换取昌德里，作为和平条件，但梅迪尼·拉奥拒绝。巴布尔的军队当夜夺取外堡，次日早晨攻下上堡。最后进攻开始仅一小时，上堡就失守，巴布尔自己也表示惊讶。梅迪尼·赖组织了惨烈的焦哈尔仪式，堡内妇女与儿童在仪式中被杀。

en.s: The Battle of Rio de Janeiro or the Battle of Guanabara Bay took place on 20 January 1567 at Rio de Janeiro that ended with the definitive defeat of the French. Specifically, the battle was an attack on the fortification of Uruçú-mirim. The Portuguese commander, Estácio de Sá, was hit by an arrow which perforated his eye, and died on 20 February.

zh.s: 里约热内卢战役又称瓜纳巴拉湾战役，于1567年1月20日在里约热内卢发生，法国军队最终在此战中被彻底击败。具体来说，战斗发生在葡萄牙军队进攻乌鲁苏米林的防御工事时。葡萄牙指挥官埃斯塔西奥·德·萨在战斗中被箭射穿眼睛，并于2月20日去世。

en.s: On 20 January 1576, Juan Bautista de Orozco founded the village of León in what is now Mexico. He established its first town council and laid out its initial streets.

zh.s: 1576年1月20日，胡安·包蒂斯塔·德·奥罗斯科在今墨西哥建立莱昂村，组建了当地首个市镇议会，并规划最初的街道。

en.s: On January 20, 1587, Shimazu forces defeated the allied Toyotomi and Ōtomo forces at Hetsugigawa, now the Ōno River, on Kyūshū, Japan. The battle took place before Toyotomi Hideyoshi’s main army arrived on the island.

zh.s: 1587年1月20日，岛津军在日本九州的户次川（今大野川）击败丰臣与大友联军。此时，丰臣秀吉的主力尚未抵达九州。

en.s: Drake's Assault on Panama also known as the Defence of Panama was a military event that took place in January 1596 during the Anglo–Spanish War. An English expedition under the command of Francis Drake and Thomas Baskerville attacked the Spanish Main via Nombre de Dios in order to cross the isthmus of Panama. Ravaged with dysentery and other diseases the English were repelled and defeated.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 德雷克袭击巴拿马又称巴拿马防御战，是英西战争期间于1596年1月发生的一场军事行动。弗朗西斯·德雷克和托马斯·巴斯克维尔率领英国远征军，经诺姆布雷-德迪奥斯袭击西属美洲大陆沿岸，试图穿越巴拿马地峡。英国士兵饱受痢疾等疾病折磨，最终被击退并战败。
zh.n: 此条记录的结束日期依据原文信息框。

en.s: The trial of Charles I took place in January 1649, marking the first time a reigning monarch was tried and executed by his own subjects. Following years of conflict during the English Civil War, which pitted the Royalists loyal to Charles I against the Parliamentarians seeking to limit his powers, the king was captured by Parliamentary forces in 1646.
en.n: The High Court of Justice for the trial of Charles I begins its proceedings.

zh.s: 查理一世的审判于1649年1月进行。这是历史上首次由臣民审判并处决在位君主。英国内战持续多年后，议会军于1646年俘获了国王。内战双方分别是支持查理一世的保王党，以及试图限制其权力的议会派。
zh.n: 查理一世受审的高级法院开始审理此案。

en.s: The Battle of Kumher was a conflict between the Kingdom of Bharatpur, led by Maharaja Suraj Mal, and the Mughal Empire, supported by its allies, including the Marathas.

en.s: Battle of Makwanpur was fought on 20 January 1763 in Makwanpurgadhi, Gorkha Kingdom between the Gorkhas and the Nawab of Bengal. The Muslims fled Makwanpur, resulted in Gorkhali victory, and the first victory of Gorkhas against overseas soldiers.

zh.s: 1763年1月20日，廓尔喀王国军队与孟加拉纳瓦卜的军队，在马克万普尔加迪交战。穆斯林军队最终逃离马克万普尔，廓尔喀人获胜。这是廓尔喀军首次战胜外来军队。

en.s: The Battle of Millstone, also known as the Battle of Van Nest's Mill, was a skirmish that occurred near the mill of Abraham Van Nest in Weston, New Jersey (near present-day Manville, New Jersey) on January 20, 1777, during the American Revolutionary War. A British foraging party was flanked and driven off by forces composed mostly of New Jersey militia, depriving the British of their wagons and supplies. This action was one of a series of skirmishes known as the Forage War that persisted in northern New Jersey through the first few months of 1777, and it demonstrated that militia companies were capable of putting up a significant fight.

zh.s: 1777年1月20日，美国独立战争中的米尔斯通战役，在新泽西州韦斯顿、今曼维尔附近亚伯拉罕·范内斯特的磨坊旁展开，因此也称范内斯特磨坊战役。主要由新泽西民兵组成的部队，从侧翼包抄一支英军粮草搜集队并将其击退，夺走他们的货车和补给。此战属于1777年前几个月在新泽西北部持续的一系列“粮草战争”小规模交战，也证明民兵连队能够进行有力抵抗。

en.t: Britain and France sign preliminary peace articles
en.s: On January 20, 1783, France and Great Britain signed preliminary articles of peace. The formal peace treaty followed on September 3, 1783.

zh.t: 英法签署初步和平条款
zh.s: 1783年1月20日，法国与英国签署初步和平条款。同年9月3日，两国签署正式和平条约。

en.s: The Battle of Rạch Gầm-Xoài Mút was fought between Tây-Sơn (Vietnamese) and Siamese forces in present-day Tiền Giang Province on January 20, 1785. It is considered one of the greatest victories in Vietnamese history.

zh.s: 1785年1月20日，越南西山军与暹罗军在今越南前江省交战。这场沥涔—吹蔑之战，被视为越南历史上最重大的胜利之一。

en.s: The Tripolitanian civil war was a conflict from 1790 to 1795 which occurred in Tripolitania – inside what is today the country of Libya. It involved a war of succession between leading members of the Karamanli dynasty, an intervention by Ottoman officer Ali Burghul who claimed to be acting on the sultan's orders and controlled Tripoli for 17 months, and an intervention by the bey of Tunis Hammuda ibn Ali to restore the Karamanlis to power.

zh.s: 的黎波里塔尼亚内战发生于1790年至1795年，地点在今天利比亚境内的的黎波里塔尼亚。战争是卡拉曼利王朝主要成员之间的继承之争。奥斯曼军官阿里·布尔古尔声称奉苏丹之命介入，并控制的黎波里17个月；突尼斯贝伊哈穆达·伊本·阿里也出兵，帮助卡拉曼利家族重新掌权。

en.s: The Battle of Cardal (also known as Battle of Cordón), on 20 January 1807, was the main conflict between the Spanish defense forces of Montevideo, Uruguay, and British troops during the siege of Montevideo during the second British invasion of the River Plate.

zh.s: 1807年1月20日，第二次英国入侵拉普拉塔河地区期间，乌拉圭蒙得维的亚的西班牙守军，与围城英军展开卡尔达尔战役，也称科尔东战役。这是围攻蒙得维的亚期间双方的主要冲突。

en.s: The Battle of Tecualoya was a military action of the Mexican War of Independence fought between 17–20 January 1812 in the canyons of Tecualoya, Mexico. The battle was fought between the royalist forces loyal to the Spanish crown and the Mexican rebels fighting for independence from the Spanish Empire. The Mexican insurgents were commanded by General Hermenegildo Galeana and the Spanish by Rosendo Porlier y Asteguieta.

zh.s: 特夸洛亚战役是墨西哥独立战争中的一次军事行动，于1812年1月17日至20日在墨西哥特夸洛亚峡谷进行。交战双方是效忠西班牙王室的保皇派和争取脱离西班牙帝国独立的墨西哥叛军。叛军由埃梅内希尔多·加莱亚纳将军指挥，西班牙军队则由罗森多·波利耶尔·伊·阿斯特吉耶塔指挥。

en.s: The siege of Ciudad Rodrigo was the successful investment of the French-occupied city of Ciudad Rodrigo by Lord Wellington's Anglo-Portuguese Army from 7–20 January 1812. Wellington's army, which numbered up to 40,000 men, faced a small French garrison of 1,800 troops under the command of Jean Léonard Barrié.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 西乌达德罗德里戈围城战（1812年）
zh.s: 惠灵顿勋爵率领的英葡联军于1812年1月7日至20日围攻被法国占领的西乌达德罗德里戈，最终成功夺取该城。惠灵顿的军队最多有4万人，面对的是让·莱奥纳尔·巴里耶指挥的1800名法军守军。

en.s: The Siege of Montevideo occurred during the War of Independence of Brazil, during which the Brazilian Army under Carlos Frederico Lecor attempted to capture the city of Montevideo in Cisplatine (now Uruguay) from the Portuguese Army of Álvaro da Costa de Sousa Macedo. The siege lasted from 20 January 1823 until 8 March 1824 when the Portuguese surrendered to the Brazilian forces. The naval defeat in the Battle of Montevideo (1823) also contributed to hasten the surrender of the Portuguese troops. The event marked the end of the resistance against independence of Brazil in its territory.

zh.s: 1823年1月20日至1824年3月8日，巴西独立战争中的蒙得维的亚围城战展开。卡洛斯·弗雷德里科·莱科尔率巴西军队，试图从阿尔瓦罗·达科斯塔·德索萨·马塞多的葡萄牙军队手中，夺取西斯普拉蒂纳，今乌拉圭，的蒙得维的亚。葡军最终投降，其在1823年蒙得维的亚海战中失利，也加快了投降。这标志着巴西境内反对独立的抵抗结束。

en.s: The Bosnian uprising was a revolt of Bosnian Ayans against the Ottoman Sultan Mahmud II. The casus belli were reforms implemented by the Sultan to abolish the ayan system. Despite winning several notable victories, the rebels were eventually defeated in a battle near Sarajevo in 1832. Internal discord contributed to the failure of the rebellion, because Gradaščević was not supported by much of the Herzegovinian ayans.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 波斯尼亚起义是波斯尼亚地方贵族反抗奥斯曼苏丹马哈茂德二世的叛乱。起因是苏丹推行改革，试图废除地方贵族制度。叛军虽取得数场重要胜利，最终仍在1832年萨拉热窝附近的一场战斗中被击败。起义失败也与内部不和有关：格拉达什切维奇没有得到许多黑塞哥维那地方贵族的支持。

en.s: The Battle of Yungay (or Yungai) effectively destroyed the Peru-Bolivian Confederation created by Bolivian Marshal Andrés de Santa Cruz in 1836. On January 20, 1839, the alliance formed Chilean Army led by Chilean General in Chief Manuel Bulnes and force of Peruvians opposed to Santa Cruz, decisively defeated the Confederate Army commanded by Santa Cruz after six hours of combat in the battlefield of Yungay, in northern Peru, 200 km north of Lima. The Chilean victory at Yungay effectively brought the Peru-Bolivian Confederation to an end, and Andrés de Santa Cruz exiled himself in Guayaquil, Ecuador.

zh.s: 1839年1月20日，智利总司令曼努埃尔·布尔内斯率领智利军队，与反对安德烈斯·德·圣克鲁斯的秘鲁部队结盟，在利马以北200公里的秘鲁北部永盖战场，经过六小时战斗，彻底击败圣克鲁斯指挥的邦联军。此役实际上瓦解了玻利维亚元帅圣克鲁斯于1836年创建的秘鲁—玻利维亚邦联。战败后，圣克鲁斯流亡厄瓜多尔瓜亚基尔。

en.s: The Battle at Pozo Hediondo took place on January 20, 1851, during the Apache Wars. On January 20, 1851, a Mexican Patrol spotted a cloud of dust just south of Pozo Hediondo ("Smelly Springs" or "Stinky Springs") where it was believed the cloud of dust was created by a returning Indians from the North with the goods they had taken from a raid.

zh.s: 1851年1月20日，阿帕奇战争中的波索埃迪翁多战役爆发。当天，一支墨西哥巡逻队在波索埃迪翁多，意为“臭泉”，以南发现一股尘土。他们认为，那是原住民从北方袭击后，带着掠获物资返回时扬起的。

en.t: 1851 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1851 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held in the 4th Wisconsin Legislature on January 20, 1851. Incumbent Democratic U.S. senator Henry Dodge was re-elected to a full six-year term. In the 1851 legislative session, Democrats held large majorities in both chambers and neither of the other parties bothered to make a formal nomination. The only real contest was in the Democratic caucuses, where Dodge narrowly won renomination.

zh.t: 1851年美国威斯康星州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1851年1月20日，威斯康星州第四届议会举行联邦参议员选举，民主党籍现任亨利·道奇连任，取得一个完整六年任期。民主党在两院都占大幅多数，其他两个政党甚至没有正式提名人选。真正的竞争只发生在民主党党团内部，道奇以微弱优势重新获得提名。

en.s: On 20 January 1871, the Battle of Buzenval near Paris, France, came to an end. The French attempt to break the Prussian siege failed; the battle had begun on 19 January.
en.n: This entry marks the end of the battle, which began on January 19.

zh.s: 1871年1月20日，法国巴黎附近的比藏瓦勒战役结束。法军试图突破普军对巴黎的包围，但未能成功。这场战役始于1月19日。
zh.n: 本条记录的是战役结束的日期；战役始于1月19日。

en.s: The Cavite mutiny of 1872 was an uprising of military personnel of Fort San Felipe, the Spanish arsenal in Cavite, Philippines on January 20, 1872. Around 200 soldiers and laborers rose up in the belief that it would elevate to a national uprising. The mutiny was unsuccessful, and government soldiers executed many of the participants and began to crack down on a burgeoning nationalist movement. Many scholars believe that the Cavite Mutiny of 1872 was the beginning of Filipino nationalism that would eventually lead to the Philippine Revolution of 1896.

zh.s: 1872年1月20日，菲律宾甲米地西班牙军械库所在地圣费利佩堡的军事人员发动起义。约200名士兵和工人参与，希望引发全国起义。兵变失败后，政府军处决许多参与者，并开始打压新兴民族主义运动。许多学者认为，这场兵变是菲律宾民族主义的开端，最终通向1896年的菲律宾革命。

en.s: The Pangkor Treaty of 1874 was a treaty signed between Great Britain and the Sultan of Perak on 20 January 1874, on the Colonial Steamer Pluto, off the coast of Perak. The treaty is significant in the history of the Malay states as it legitimised British control of the Malay rulers and paved the way for British imperialism in Malaya.

zh.s: 1874年邦咯条约于1874年1月20日签署，签约双方是大不列颠与霹雳苏丹。签署地点是停泊在霹雳海岸外的“冥王星号”殖民地蒸汽船。该条约使英国对马来统治者的控制获得合法地位，并为英国在马来亚扩张帝国势力铺平道路，因此在马来诸邦历史上意义重大。

en.s: The Zungwini Mountain skirmishes took place on 20, 22 and 24 January 1879 during the Anglo-Zulu War. The mountain was a stronghold of the AbaQulusi Zulu tribe, who were reinforced by the forces of exiled Swazi prince Mbilini waMswati. The mountain lay near the proposed route of advance of a British column under Lieutenant-Colonel Evelyn Wood, one of three that marched on the Zulu capital, Ulundi, from early January.

zh.s: 祖鲁战争期间，双方于1879年1月20日、22日和24日在宗格温尼山交战。该山是阿巴夸鲁西祖鲁人的据点，流亡的斯威士兰王子姆比利尼·瓦姆斯瓦蒂率军前来增援。英国军队计划从该山附近推进。1月初，埃夫琳·伍德中校率领的一支英军纵队已向祖鲁首都乌伦迪进发，三支纵队均以此为目标。

en.t: 1887 United States Senate election in California
en.s: The 1887 United States Senate election in California was held on January 20, 1887, by the California State Legislature to elect a U.S. senator (Class 1) to represent the State of California in the United States Senate. In a special joint session, former Democratic Senator George Hearst was elected over Republican State Senator Henry Vrooman.

zh.t: 1887年美国加利福尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1887年1月20日，加利福尼亚州议会举行联邦参议员选举，改选该州第一组席位。两院特别联席会议选出民主党籍前参议员乔治·赫斯特，击败共和党州参议员亨利·弗鲁曼。

en.t: Gloria Macapagal Arroyo begins her presidency
en.s: On January 20, 2001, Gloria Macapagal Arroyo was sworn in as president of the Philippines during the political crisis that removed Joseph Estrada from power. Chief Justice Hilario Davide Jr. administered the oath.

zh.t: 格洛丽亚·马卡帕加尔·阿罗约宣誓就任总统

en.s: Royal Rumble (2002) was the fifteenth annual Royal Rumble professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF). It was presented by Square's Final Fantasy X. It took place on January 20, 2002, at the Philips Arena in Atlanta, Georgia. It was the final Royal Rumble event produced under the WWF banner. The main event was the Royal Rumble match, which Triple H won, after last eliminating Kurt Angle.

zh.s: 2002年1月20日，世界摔角联盟（WWF）在美国佐治亚州亚特兰大的飞利浦竞技场，举办第15届年度“皇家大战”按次付费职业摔角赛，由Square公司的《最终幻想X》冠名呈现。这是最后一次以WWF名义制作皇家大战。压轴皇家大战中，Triple H最后淘汰科特·安格，赢得比赛。

en.s: The Karbala provincial headquarters raid was an infiltration attack carried out on January 20, 2007 by insurgent commandos, with possible Iranian involvement, on the American contingent of the Joint Security Station located within the Iraqi Police headquarters. The assault, which left five American soldiers dead and three wounded, has been called the "boldest and most sophisticated attack in four years of warfare" and is furthermore notable for being one of the few instances when militants have actually managed to capture U.S. soldiers.

zh.t: 伊拉克卡尔巴拉省总部突袭
zh.s: 2007年1月20日，叛乱突击队潜入伊拉克警方总部内的联合安全站，袭击其中美军分队，伊朗可能参与其事。袭击造成五名美军死亡、三人受伤，被称为“四年战争中最大胆、最复杂的攻击”。这也是少数武装人员真正成功俘获美国士兵的事件之一。

en.s: A parliamentary election to the National Assembly of People's Power was held in Cuba on 20 January 2008. According to the Cuban electoral system, one candidate was nominated for each of the 614 seats in the Assembly, and candidates were elected if they received at least 50% of the vote. The candidates are otherwise proposed by nominating assemblies, which comprise representatives of workers, youth, women, students and farmers as well as members of the Committees for the Defense of the Revolution, after initial mass meetings soliciting a first list of names.

zh.s: 2008年1月20日，古巴举行全国人民政权代表大会选举。依照古巴选举制度，议会614席各有一名候选人，取得至少50%选票即可当选。最初通过群众会议征集候选名单，再由提名大会提出人选。提名大会由工人、青年、妇女、学生、农民及保卫革命委员会的代表组成。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Serbia on January 20 and February 3, 2008. Incumbent President Boris Tadić was re-elected as president in the second round with 51% of the vote, defeating challenger Tomislav Nikolić. The elections for president were the first since Serbia became independent, when the State Union of Serbia and Montenegro was dissolved by the secession of Montenegro in 2006.

zh.s: 塞尔维亚于2008年1月20日和2月3日举行总统选举。现任总统鲍里斯·塔迪奇在第二轮投票中以51%的得票率连任，击败挑战者托米斯拉夫·尼科利奇。这是塞尔维亚独立后的首次总统选举；2006年，黑山脱离塞尔维亚和黑山国家联盟，该联盟随之解体。

en.s: The Operation Dawn 8: Gulf of Aden (Malay: Operasi Fajar 8) was a naval operation carried out by the Royal Malaysian Navy against pirates in the Indian Ocean on 20 January 2011. In response to the hijacking of the MV Bunga Laurel, the Malaysian Shipborne Protection Team sent an attack helicopter and 14 members of the naval counter-terrorism group PASKAL in two RHIB boats to retake the vessel and rescue the crew. After one night of trailing the tanker, the Malaysian forces successfully retook the ship by force on 20 January 2011, resulting in the wounding of three and the capture of four out of 18 pirate, and all 23 vessel crewmembers rescued.

zh.s: 2011年1月20日，马来西亚皇家海军在印度洋实施反海盗行动“黎明8号：亚丁湾”。“Bunga Laurel”号遭劫持后，马来西亚舰载护卫队派出攻击直升机，并让14名海军反恐部队PASKAL成员乘两艘硬式充气艇出动。跟踪油轮一夜后，马军于1月20日武力夺回船只。18名海盗中有三人受伤、四人被捕，船上23名船员全部获救。

en.s: The 2013 Beni special gubernatorial election was held on 20 January 2013. The elections were held to replace the interim governor of Beni Department with an elected executive who will serve until 2015. Numerous observers described the election as an important test of political strength in eastern Bolivia: a MAS victory would signal the retreat of the Media Luna right-wing alliance to Santa Cruz department alone; while a Beni First victory would dash MAS political ambitions in the department. Prior to the election, Beni had an interim governor, Haysen Ribera Leigue, who was selected by the Departmental Legislative Assembly on 16 December 2011.

zh.t: 2013年玻利维亚贝尼省省长特别选举
zh.s: 2013年1月20日，玻利维亚贝尼省举行省长特别选举，以民选行政首长接替临时省长，任期至2015年。许多观察者将其视为东部政治实力的重要测试：如果争取社会主义运动获胜，意味着右翼“半月地带”联盟将退守圣克鲁斯一省；如果“贝尼优先”获胜，则会挫败争取社会主义运动在当地的政治目标。选举前，代理省长为海森·里韦拉·莱格，他于2011年12月16日由省立法议会选出。

en.s: A state election was held in Lower Saxony on 20 January 2013 to elect the 137 members of the Landtag. They were replaced by an SPD-Green coalition, which has a one-seat majority.

en.s: The 2022 Supercopa Internacional was the 1st edition of the Supercopa Internacional, an international version of the Supercopa Argentina, the annual football match contested by the winners of the Primera División and Copa Argentina competitions.
